title: Education
question: Why is education democratic in bookless tribal societies?

meanings.usage: 描述体现人人平等、权利共享的制度或状态
通常修饰条件、环境等负面的客观因素
常用搭配deprive sb. of sth.，表示夺走某人本该拥有的事物
可指资金投入，也可指抽象资源的投入，常用搭配invest in sth.
修饰人或政策，指具备理性认知、思想进步的
文中表示“穿插、点缀”，指某事物在过程中反复出现
可指继承具体财物，也可指传承文化、特征等抽象事物

meanings.meaning: 有约束力的；必须遵守的
meanings.usage: 常修饰协议、义务等，常用搭配be binding on sb.
作名词指不识字的人，作形容词表示无读写能力的
常修饰教育、课程、规定等，指必须执行的
正式用语，相当于consider，常用结构deem it + adj. + to do sth.
指阻碍进程、活动或人的发展，语气比hinder稍强
用于修饰和未成年人相关的事物，正式用语
常和juvenile搭配，指未成年人的不良或犯罪行为

phrases.usage: 表示“剥夺某人的某物，使某人丧失某物”，是被动语境下的常用搭配

examples.en: The unfair law deprived many people of their right to vote.
examples.zh: 这项不公平的法律剥夺了许多人的投票权。

examples.en: Lack of sleep deprived him of the energy to finish the task.
examples.zh: 睡眠不足让他丧失了完成任务的精力。

phrases.usage: 既可以指资金上投资某领域，也可以指投入时间、精力等资源到某事物中

examples.en: The government plans to invest more in renewable energy.
examples.zh: 政府计划在可再生能源领域投入更多资金。

examples.en: It is wise to invest in your own professional skills.
examples.zh: 为自己的职业技能投入资源是很明智的。

phrases.usage: 表示“强调；重视”，等同于put emphasis on，用于说明关注的重点

examples.en: Many schools lay too much stress on exam results.
examples.zh: 很多学校过分强调考试成绩。

examples.en: The company lays stress on teamwork and innovation.
examples.zh: 这家公司重视团队合作和创新。

phrases.usage: 表示“仿照…制作；模仿…的模式”，指以某事物为范本设计

examples.en: The new library is fashioned after a famous ancient building.
examples.zh: 这座新图书馆是仿照一座著名古建筑设计的。

examples.en: Their education system is fashioned after the French model.
examples.zh: 他们的教育体系是仿照法国模式建立的。

phrases.usage: 表示“对…有约束力”，用于说明规则、义务的强制效力

examples.en: The contract is binding on all parties involved.
examples.zh: 这份合同对所有相关方都有约束力。

examples.en: This regulation is binding to every employee.
examples.zh: 这项规定对所有员工都有效力。

phrases.usage: 表示“有权享有；有资格获得”，用于说明某人理应拥有某种权利或待遇

examples.en: All citizens are entitled to equal protection under the law.
examples.zh: 所有公民都有权受到法律的平等保护。

examples.en: You are entitled to a 10-day paid annual leave if you work here for one year.
examples.zh: 如果你在这里工作满一年，就有权享受10天的带薪年假。

phrases.usage: 表示“面临；面对（困难、问题等）”，强调被动遇到棘手的状况

examples.en: When he graduated, he was confronted with a very competitive job market.
examples.zh: 他毕业时面临着竞争非常激烈的就业市场。

examples.en: Many small businesses are confronted with financial difficulties after the pandemic.
examples.zh: 疫情过后很多小企业都面临着财务困境。

phrases.usage: 表示“是…的问题；关乎…的事”，用于说明某事物的本质

examples.en: Success in this field is not just a matter of luck.
examples.zh: 在这个领域取得成功不仅仅是运气的问题。

examples.en: Protecting the environment is a matter of great importance for future generations.
examples.zh: 保护环境对后代来说是至关重要的事。

sentences.en: Education is one of the key words of our time.
sentences.zh: 教育是我们这个时代的一个关键词。

sentences.en: A man without an education, many of us believe,
sentences.zh: 许多人认为，一个没有受过教育的人

sentences.en: is an unfortunate victim of adverse circumstances, deprived of one of the greatest twentieth-century opportunities.
sentences.zh: 是不幸境遇的受害者，被剥夺了20世纪最伟大的机会之一。

sentences.en: Convinced of the importance of education, modern states 'invest' in institutions of learning to get back 'interest'
sentences.zh: 现代国家深信教育的重要性，因此“投资”于学习机构，以期“回报”

sentences.en: in the form of a large group of enlightened young men and women who are potential leaders.
sentences.zh: 一大批开明的青年男女，他们是潜在的领导者。

sentences.en: Education, with its cycles of instruction so carefully worked out,
sentences.zh: 教育，有着精心设计的教学周期，

sentences.en: punctuated by textbooks--those purchasable wells of wisdom--what would civilization be like without its benefits?
sentences.zh: 以教科书——那些可以购买的智慧源泉——作为点缀，如果没有它的益处，文明会是什么样子？

sentences.en: So much is certain: that we would have doctors and preachers,
sentences.zh: 有一点是肯定的：我们会有医生和传教士，

sentences.en: lawyers and defendants marriages and births--but our spiritual outlook would be different.
sentences.zh: 律师和被告，婚姻和生育——但我们的精神观念会大相径庭。

sentences.en: We would lay less stress on 'facts and figures' and more on a good memory,
sentences.zh: 我们会更少强调“事实和数据”，而更多地关注良好的记忆力，

sentences.en: on applied psychology, and on the capacity of a man to get along with his fellow-citizens.
sentences.zh: 关注应用心理学，以及一个人与同胞和睦相处的能力。

sentences.en: If our educational system were fashioned after its bookless past we would have the most democratic form of 'college' imaginable.
sentences.zh: 如果我们的教育体系仿效其没有书籍的过去，我们就会拥有 imaginable 最民主的“大学”形式。

sentences.en: Among tribal people all knowledge inherited by tradition is shared by all;
sentences.zh: 在部落民族中，所有通过传统继承的知识都由所有人共享；

sentences.en: it is taught to every member of the tribe so that in this respect everybody is equally equipped for life.
sentences.zh: 它被传授给部落的每一个成员，因此在这方面，每个人都同样具备了生活的能力。

sentences.en: It is the ideal condition of the 'equal start' which only our most progressive forms of modern education try to regain.
sentences.zh: 这是“平等起步”的理想条件，只有我们最进步的现代教育形式才试图重新获得。

sentences.en: In primitive cultures the obligation to seek and to receive the traditional instruction is binding to all.
sentences.zh: 在原始文化中，寻求和接受传统教育的义务对所有人都有约束力。

sentences.en: There are no'illiterates' --if the term can be applied to peoples without a script--while our own compulsory school attendance became law in Germany in 1642,
sentences.zh: 没有“文盲”——如果这个词可以用来指没有文字的民族的话——而我们自己的义务入学制度于1642年在德国成为法律，

sentences.en: in France in 1806, and in England in 1876 and is still nonexistent in a number of 'civilized' nations.
sentences.zh: 1806年在法国，1876年在英国，并且在一些“文明”国家仍然不存在。

sentences.en: This shows how long it was before we deemed it necessary to make sure
sentences.zh: 这表明我们花了多长时间才认为有必要确保

sentences.en: that all our children could share in the knowledge accumulated by the 'happy few' during the past centuries.
sentences.zh: 我们的所有孩子都能分享过去几个世纪由“少数幸运儿”积累的知识。

sentences.en: Education in the wilderness is not a matter of monetary means.
sentences.zh: 荒野中的教育并非金钱问题。

sentences.en: All are entitled to an equal start.
sentences.zh: 所有人都有权获得平等的起步。

sentences.en: There is none of the hurry which, in our society, often hampers the full development of a growing personality.
sentences.zh: 那里没有我们社会中常常阻碍一个成长中的人格充分发展的匆忙。

sentences.en: There, a child grows up under the everpresent attention of his parents;
sentences.zh: 在那里，孩子在父母无时无刻的关怀下成长；

sentences.en: therefore the jungles and the savannahs know of no 'juvenile delinquency'.
sentences.zh: 因此，丛林和热带草原上没有“青少年犯罪”。

sentences.en: No necessity of making a living away from home results in neglect of children, and no father is confronted with his inability to 'buy' an education for his child.
sentences.zh: 没有离家谋生的必要导致儿童被忽视，也没有父亲面临无法为孩子“购买”教育的困境。

exercises.prompt: “用来描述和当下真实情况不符的假设，表达想象、愿望、建议等含义” 描述的是哪个语法点？
exercises.hint: If + 主语 + 动词过去式（be动词用were）, 主语 + would/could/might + 动词原形
options: 宾语从句（deduce后接并列宾语从句）
让步状语从句：though引导的让步结构
虚拟语气（与现在事实相反的情况）
exercises.explain: 虚拟语气（与现在事实相反的情况）：If + 主语 + 动词过去式（be动词用were）, 主语 + would/could/might + 动词原形：当假设的条件在当前现实中不成立时使用，体现非真实的推测

source.title: 虚拟语气（与现在事实相反的情况）

exercises.prompt:
选出下面句子的正确中文意思：
If our educational system were fashioned after its bookless past we would have the most democratic form of 'college' imaginable.
options: 1925年左右，将20或30页信息交给任何一个世界主要大国，
首先，脑电图仪（它只是一种通过将电极连接到头皮来记录大脑电活动的设备）
如果我们的教育体系仿效其没有书籍的过去，我们就会拥有 imaginable 最民主的“大学”形式。
几乎每天都能看到一只幼年海豚试图把一只300磅重的海龟翻过来，它把鼻子伸到海龟壳的边缘下面，拼命地往上顶。
exercises.explain: If our educational system were fashioned after its bookless past we would have the most democratic form of 'college' imaginable. — 如果我们的教育体系仿效其没有书籍的过去，我们就会拥有 imaginable 最民主的“大学”形式。

source.en: If our educational system were fashioned after its bookless past we would have the most democratic form of 'college' imaginable.

grammar.title: 虚拟语气（与现在事实相反的情况）
grammar.definition: 用来描述和当下真实情况不符的假设，表达想象、愿望、建议等含义
grammar.structure: If + 主语 + 动词过去式（be动词用were）, 主语 + would/could/might + 动词原形
grammar.usage: 当假设的条件在当前现实中不成立时使用，体现非真实的推测

examples.en: If our educational system were fashioned after its bookless past we would have the most democratic form of 'college' imaginable.
examples.zh: 如果我们的教育制度效仿没有书籍的古代模式，我们就会拥有能想象到的最民主的“大学”形式。

examples.en: If I had more free time, I would learn to play the piano.
examples.zh: 如果我有更多空闲时间，我会去学弹钢琴。

examples.en: If there were no mobile phones, people would communicate more face to face.
examples.zh: 如果没有手机，人们会更多地面对面交流。

grammar.title: 插入语
grammar.definition: 嵌入句子中、不作句子主干成分，用于补充说明说话者的态度、解释背景等，删除后句子语法依然完整
grammar.structure: 常置于句子中间，用逗号和主干隔开，形式可以是短语、从句等
grammar.usage: 用来丰富信息，使表达更自然，体现说话者的补充观点

examples.en: A man without an education, many of us believe, is an unfortunate victim of adverse circumstances.
examples.zh: 我们许多人都认为，没有受过教育的人是不利环境的不幸受害者。

examples.en: The new policy, I think, will bring great benefits to local residents.
examples.zh: 我认为这项新政策会给当地居民带来很大好处。

examples.en: This movie, to be honest, is not as interesting as I expected.
examples.zh: 说实话，这部电影没有我预期的那么有趣。

patterns.pattern: Convinced of..., sb./sth. do sth. to...

original.en: Convinced of the importance of education, modern states 'invest' in institutions of learning to get back 'interest' in the form of a large group of enlightened young men and women who are potential leaders.
original.zh: 现代国家深信教育的重要性，便向教育机构“投资”，以获得大批有知识的青年男女作为“利息”，这些人是未来的潜在领导者。

examples.en: Convinced of the importance of physical health, many young people choose to exercise 3 times a week to keep fit.
examples.zh: 深信身体健康的重要性，很多年轻人选择每周锻炼三次来保持身材。

examples.en: Convinced of the value of traditional culture, the local government organizes various cultural activities every year to promote inheritance of folk art.
examples.zh: 深信传统文化的价值，当地政府每年都会组织各类文化活动来推动民间艺术的传承。

patterns.pattern: This shows how long it was before we deemed it necessary to do sth.

original.en: This shows how long it was before we deemed it necessary to make sure that all our children could share in the knowledge accumulated by the 'happy few' during the past centuries.
original.zh: 这说明我们过了很久才意识到，有必要让所有儿童都能共享过去几个世纪里“少数幸运儿”积累起来的知识。

examples.en: This shows how long it was before we deemed it necessary to strictly limit plastic use to protect the ocean.
examples.zh: 这说明我们过了很久才意识到，有必要严格限制塑料使用来保护海洋。

examples.en: This shows how long it was before we deemed it necessary to provide mental health support for students in primary schools.
examples.zh: 这说明我们过了很久才意识到，有必要为小学生提供心理健康支持。

patterns.pattern: No necessity of doing sth. results in..., and no sb. is confronted with...

original.en: No necessity of making a living away from home results in neglect of children, and no father is confronted with his inability to 'buy' an education for his child.
original.zh: 人们没有必要外出谋生，所以不会造成对孩子的忽视，也没有父亲会面临无力为孩子“购买”教育的困境。

examples.en: No necessity of working overtime results in more time for people to spend with their family, and no employee is confronted with the problem of work-life imbalance.
examples.zh: 人们没有必要加班，所以有更多时间陪伴家人，也没有员工会面临工作与生活失衡的问题。

examples.en: No necessity of worrying about food shortage results in a stable social environment, and no resident is confronted with the difficulty of affording basic food.
examples.zh: 人们没有必要担心食物短缺，所以社会环境稳定，也没有居民会面临负担不起基本食物的困境。
